note.text: Half the Fortune 500 will not survive the next decade, and the reason has nothing to do with whether their AI is good enough. Capability is already ahead of most organizations' willingness to redesign a workflow, a reporting line, or a budget around it. Incumbents keep bolting automation onto an org chart built for a slower world, then wonder why a leaner competitor eats the margin. The companies that disappear will not be the ones that used AI poorly — they will be the ones that used it politely.
